meta.title: Captae · Save online videos to your device
meta.description: Paste a link or click on a page to save courses, clips, and videos to your device. Pick quality, search speech, get subtitles, and edit.

hero.eyebrow: Video saver for desktop and mobile
hero.title: Save good videos to your device
hero.subtitle: Paste a link to save courses, clips, or favorite videos in any quality, get subtitles, and search by line.
hero.note: Free, no sign up, videos stay on your device

stage.caption: From pasting a link to saving and subtitles

sites.lead: Save from the video sites you visit

showcase.title: Four pages to manage videos
showcase.body: Here's the real app. Switch views, pick quality, see progress, click any button.

captions.downloads: See file sizes for each quality and track queued or done items.
captions.library: Saved videos stay organized. Search lines, trim, and convert.
captions.agent: Connect your AI tools in one click and see a log of every action.
captions.extension: Adds a download button to web videos so you can pick quality.

pick.title: See the size of each quality
pick.body: Paste a link to see how much space each quality takes. Pick one yourself, or wait a few seconds and it starts in the highest quality.

login.title: Sign in once for member videos
login.body: Some courses, higher qualities, or saved videos need a site login. Sign in once inside the app and future downloads work right away.

reasons.title: See which step is needed next
reasons.body: No cryptic errors. Whether you need to sign in, verify on the page, or check region access, you get a plain answer and a next button.

examples.text: You need to sign in to Bilibili to watch this video
YouTube needs you to confirm on the web page first (verification)
This video isn't available in your region
This video is copy-protected (DRM). Captae can't download it

library.title: Find any video by a line you remember
library.body: Even a big library is easy to search. Type a word to find that spoken clip, then trim, merge, add subtitles, or convert formats.

speech.title: Turn speech into text on your device
speech.body: For talks or interviews without captions, one click creates timed subtitles and a transcript on your device. Audio never leaves.

live.title: Record live streams as they happen
live.body: For live talks or shows with no replay, paste the link to detect the stream. Start recording from now, stop anytime, and save the video.

extension.title: Click beside any web video to save it
extension.body: With the extension, skip copying links. A button appears next to playing web videos so you can pick a quality and save right there.
points: Button by the video, no copying
Pick quality and see live progress

ai.title: Let your AI tools save and find video clips
ai.body: Connect Claude or Cursor in one click. Ask it to download videos, find clips with a specific spoken line, or create subtitles hands free.
points: One click to connect or turn off
Clear history of every action taken

log.did: Convert Big Buck Bunny to MP3

send.title: Skip long watches and let AI summarize
send.body: For a long talk or tutorial, click Send to AI to copy the transcript and key frames. Paste them into a chat and ask what the video covers.

local.title: No account needed, videos stay with you
local.body: Open and use with no sign up. Your saved videos, subtitles, and search history stay on your device.
points: No sign up, ready on launch
Common formats for play and edit
On device speech to text, private

opensource.title: Totally free, code out in the sun
opensource.body: All features are free with no ads or limits. The full code is open on GitHub so the road grows wider and you never worry.

final.title: Save your next favorite video
final.subtitle: No sign up needed. Paste a link and keep the videos you care about.

footer.tagline: Free video downloader and media library for macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, and iOS
footer.legal: Only download content you have rights to use and follow site terms and local laws.
footer.credits: Demo footage from four Blender Foundation open movies: Big Buck Bunny, Sintel, Tears of Steel, and Elephants Dream, used under CC BY 3.0 (CC BY 2.5 for Elephants Dream), © Blender Foundation.

Click failed videos to see why and next steps
